updates.note: Management reaffirmed the target of reaching a $2 billion run rate by the end of FY27.
updates.quote: the $2 billion by FY27, that's a run rate. We are marching towards it steadily.

updates.note: The $5 billion FY31 aspiration was not mentioned in this call.
Management reported the effective tax rate for FY26 at 22.6%, which is within the 20% to 24% range.
updates.quote: Effective tax rate for FY26 stood at 22.6%.
